component.name: Biblioteca de Epubs
component.summary: EPUB library manager organized by series

description.p: Biblioteca de Epubs is a desktop application for managing and organizing your EPUB ebook collection by series, with automatic metadata extraction, cover art, reading progress tracking, and intelligent search.

Features include recursive EPUB scanning with localStorage cache, metadata extraction (title, author, series state), series grid with dominant-tint coloring and reading progress bars, volume detail view with read/unread/pending status tracking, fuzzy search (Ctrl+K), smart sorting, dark and light themes, statistics dashboard, and persistent state management.

ul.li: About Modal — Added an "About / Sobre" modal with system information, credits, and a link to Ko-fi for voluntary contributions.
External Links — Links to Ko-fi and GitHub in the About modal now open seamlessly in the user's default browser rather than inside the Electron container.
Menu Bar Removal — Removed the default Electron system menu bar (File/Edit/View/Window/Help) to achieve a cleaner, app-like visual interface.
Light Theme — Toggle between dark and light themes with persistent localStorage. Anti-flash script prevents flicker on load.
Statistics Dashboard — Modal with 4 summary cards (series, volumes, read, progress), state breakdown chart, largest series ranking, and 30-day activity timeline (pure CSS/SVG).
WCAG Fixes — Button contrast improved (accent darkened, white text on primary buttons), state badges darkened for white card backgrounds, detail view tint gradient boosted.
Ghost Toolbar Buttons — Stats, folder select, and refresh buttons now use transparent/ghost style matching the theme toggle for visual consistency.
Windows Builds — NSIS installer + portable .exe available, validated on Windows 11.
i18n — 41 total keys (PT/EN), automatic system language detection.
